description: This bar chart, titled "How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary Perception," illustrates the popularity scores for five different large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), ChatGPT (yellow), Acc=0 & GT Ans (light gray with crosshatch), and Acc=0 & Gene Ans (light gray with diagonal hatch)—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, while the vertical axis, labeled "Popularity," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 220 in increments of 20. For each domain, five bars are displayed side-by-side, each corresponding to one model and differentiated by color and pattern as indicated in the legend. In the "Movies" category, Llama3 scores approximately 30, Qwen2 approximately 25, ChatGPT approximately 20, Acc=0 & GT Ans approximately 15, and Acc=0 & Gene Ans approximately 10. In the "Songs" category, Llama3 scores approximately 70, Qwen2 approximately 65, ChatGPT approximately 55, Acc=0 & GT Ans approximately 50, and Acc=0 & Gene Ans approximately 45. In the "Basketball" category, Llama3 scores approximately 170, Qwen2 approximately 105, ChatGPT approximately 100, Acc=0 & GT Ans approximately 95, and Acc=0 & Gene Ans approximately 90. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the model legend, and none are visually emphasized beyond their distinct color and pattern.
